title: Run the CV run's GitHub deep-dive inside the analyze task, not beside it
deviations_from_card: (1) Capability on /api/analyze is a boolean can("pipeline:write") read, not requireCapability: the card says the handle is dropped with a code while the CV run starts, which is a decision and not a refusal; it also keeps analyze/route.ts on route-capability-coverage's allowlist untouched (a GATE match there would have required deleting that line, outside the write set). (2) The stage is reached through the existing late-bound runner registry (task-external-runners.ts, key analyze_github), registered at module load by /api/analyze, because analyze-run.ts is on tasks.ts's graph and the GitHub harvest (+13 modules) would have broken the perf ceilings of every task-hub route. The house home for such registrations is late-bound-boot.ts, but that file is outside the write set; consequence: an analyze task replayed after a process restart, before /api/analyze is hit, reports githubDeepDive ANALYSIS_FAILED (panel offers Retry). Moving the registration to late-bound-boot.ts is a 5-line follow-up. (3) The PATCH effect in useAnalyzeForm was kept (not deleted) but narrowed to the panel's Retry, which still runs through /api/github-analysis and would otherwise never be persisted; the task marks its own slug so it is never written twice. The restore effect and resumedRef were deleted. (4) The github-analysis limiter is charged at the route whenever a non-blind, authorized handle rides a run that passed the reservation gate, including runs whose deep-dive then hits the TTL cache (the route cannot know a file-JD's cache key). (5) perf-budget.json (shared surface, under lock) raised: /api/analyze 226->239 modules, 3000->3110 KB; approve 3002->3006 KB and letter 3020->3022 KB for analyze-run.ts/schemas.ts growth (~3 KB, no module). githubRunIdRef/githubAbortRef stay: GitHub-only runs and Retry still own a browser request.
notes: Blind is enforced server-side in three places: the route never forwards a handle on a blind run (not even onto the task row), startGithubStage in analyze-run answers skipped, and runGithubStage answers skipped before any read/spend/write. Gate notes: tsc exit 1 only on the untracked foreign kpi-sim/ tree (no error in the repo tree). Full test:unit exit 1 on sibling in-flight work only: erasure-full-scrub (job_workspace_state, db-jobs card) and route-tenancy-coverage (getJob() workspace arg, db-jobs card), plus two flakes (python-runner-concurrency, resend-dedup) unrelated to this card; every test file in the touched dirs is green. test:perf exit 1: llm-config/job-ingest are the known pre-existing lines; the remaining KB overages (redraft, approve, promote, jds/generate, interview-kit, letter, page.tsx) come from sibling in-flight files - measured in an isolated worktree of base + this card only, the tree is within budget except the two known lines. api:check green (no auth-posture change: the capability is a boolean read). Integration: card B (analyze-engine/B) edits useAnalyzeForm.ts and the candidates README after this; onResult now calls applyGithubDeepDive(parsed), and a restored-from-row result (B) should fill githubAnalysis from the saved row's githubAnalysis as before.
